name: Slimy Menace

angles.text: Protecting Crystal Lake's shores helps keep local Elwynn fishermen and travelers near Goldshire safe from aggressive murloc raids.
As a human, your people in Elwynn Forest face murloc encroachment that threatens their waterways, food supply, and nearby settlements.

faq.answer: Murlocs along Crystal Lake's far shores threaten the fish and anyone working or traveling nearby. Left unchecked, they can devour the local fish supply.
faq.q: What is the quest Slimy Menace about?

faq.answer: The disturbance is at Crystal Lake in Elwynn Forest, where murlocs have gathered on the opposite shoreline. They disrupt the lake's wildlife and endanger local residents.
faq.q: Where do the events of this quest take place?

aliases: what is the problem with murlocs
faq.answer: Murlocs rapidly deplete the lake's fish and terrorize the surrounding area with fierce tempers and sharp teeth. Thinning their ranks helps protect the fishery and slows their aggressive expansion for a time.
faq.q: Why must the murlocs at Crystal Lake be culled?

faq.answer: No. Thinning the murlocs offers only a temporary reprieve. They reproduce and regroup swiftly, so their numbers recover despite initial losses.
faq.q: Does clearing the murlocs permanently resolve the problem?

faq.answer: An Elwynn local concerned about Crystal Lake asks for help. Distressed by the murlocs' unsettling warbling and voracious appetite, they want the murlocs thinned to protect the fishery.
faq.q: Who asks for help with the slimy menace?

faq.answer: Murlocs are vicious, temperamental amphibious creatures with sharp teeth and a guttural warble. They gather along shores, aggressively defend their territory, and attack anything that ventures too close to their feeding grounds.
faq.q: What makes the murlocs such a threat?

sections.body: Aggressive murlocs have settled along Crystal Lake's eastern shore. Sharp teeth and fierce tempers make the water dangerous for anyone who fishes or comes near. Local residents depend on the lake for their livelihoods, and the murlocs threaten them at the water's edge.
sections.title: Trouble at Crystal Lake

sections.body: If their numbers grow unchecked, murlocs may devour every fish in the lake. Thinning them gives the waters respite, though their eerie, echoing warbles warn that they persist. Even when scattered, they replenish their ranks swiftly, so the shoreline needs constant watch.
sections.title: An Endless Infestation

summary: At Crystal Lake in Elwynn Forest, murlocs threaten the fish and people along the shore. Their growing numbers endanger the lake's supply and nearby locals.
